entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The eastern continent of Ixalan, dominated by vampires and ruled by an alliance of a powerful church and an iron-fisted monarch.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane containing Torrezon, home of Orazca and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: The mountainous capital territory and seat of the monarchy, once a small religious city-state.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The undead vampire army and ruling power of Torrezon, formed under the order of Saint Elenda.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: A vampire custodian of the Immortal Sun who gave the gift of vampirism to Alta Torrezon's loyalists; later venerated as a saint.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact stolen from Alta Torrezon by the sphinx Azor; the Legion of Dusk twice lost it.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A sphinx who stole the Immortal Sun from Alta Torrezon.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The current queen of Alta Torrezon, aligned with the church orthodoxy and struggling to keep order after the invasion.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: The new pontifex who directs the church orthodoxy.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: The Antifex whom the church radicals and myriad separatists follow.

entities.name: Apostasine princes
entities.description: The two brothers who rebelled against their sister and the church, starting the Apostasine Wars.

entities.name: Apostasine Wars
entities.description: A long civil war in Alta Torrezon between the crown and church and the apostasine princes.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A group established by refugees and exiles from nations defeated by Torrezon.

entities.name: Rite of Redemption
entities.description: The ritual blessing of the chosen with vampirism.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that devastated Torrezon's western Free Cities.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The site of the Legion of Dusk's humiliation on Ixalan.

entities.name: Deoro
entities.description: A continent-bisecting river between the Free Cities and Alta Torrezon.

entities.name: Torrezon separatists
entities.description: Myriad separatists organized under Vona who oppose Queen Miralda's rule.

events.summary: The dead monarch's children split the kingdom; the sister refuses her brothers' demand to divide her inheritance and civil war erupts.
events.quote: She refused, and Alta Torrezon exploded into civil war.

events.summary: The church declares the brothers heretics and the Apostasine Wars begin.
events.quote: Quickly, most of the church's leadership declared the brothers to be heretics, apostates who had turned from the divine plan to glorify themselves.

events.summary: The civil war rages for two hundred and fifty years.
events.quote: The civil war raged on for two hundred and fifty years, with the children of all three rulers carrying on the conflict.

events.summary: As defeat seems certain, Elenda charges into the apostate princes' guard and routs their army.
events.quote: Just as defeat seemed certain, a stranger emerged: wreathed in rippling black vapor, this rider charged into the honor guard of the apostate princes, slaughtering all in her path.

events.summary: Loyalist nobility partake of Elenda's gift of vampirism, the Rite of Redemption.
events.quote: With the church's blessing, loyalist nobility partook of Elenda's gift.

events.summary: Strengthened by vampirism, the rulers begin a campaign of conquest across the continent.
events.quote: Bolstered with vampiric strength and appetite, they began a campaign of conquest across the continent.

events.summary: An undead army crosses the Deoro and calls itself the Legion of Dusk.
events.quote: They called themselves the Legion of Dusk .

events.summary: Over four centuries Alta Torrezon swallows kingdoms and drives refugees toward the coast.
events.quote: For four more centuries, the armies of Alta Torrezon inexorably swallowed up kingdom after kingdom, expanding outward from their mountainous home, driving waves of refugees toward the free cities on the coast.

events.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

events.summary: Torrezon is not spared the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The continent of Torrezon was not spared the New Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: Queen Miralda's order for paladins to hold back while the Free Cities were butchered draws church condemnation.
events.quote: Queen Miralda 's order for paladins to stay their blades while the Free Cities were butchered drew condemnation from a growing faction of the Church.

events.summary: Church factions form behind Pontifex Mavren Fein and Antifex Vona de Iedo, with separatists opposing Queen Miralda.
events.quote: The radicals look to Antifex Vona de Iedo for guidance.

relations.note: Torrezon is the eastern continent of Ixalan.
relations.quote: Torrezon is the eastern continent of Ixalan .

relations.note: The Legion of Dusk rules the continent.
relations.quote: It is ruled by the Legion of Dusk .

relations.note: The capital lies in the far northeast mountains.
relations.quote: deep in Torrezon's interior in the far northeast amid a vast mountain range.

relations.note: Azor stole the Immortal Sun from Alta Torrezon.
relations.quote: stolen centuries prior from Alta Torrezon by the sphinx Azor .

relations.note: Miralda is de facto aligned with the pontifex and church orthodoxy.
relations.quote: Queen Miralda is de facto aligned with the pontifex and the church orthodoxy.

relations.note: Vona leads the separatists opposed to Queen Miralda.
relations.quote: Aligned against her rule are myriad separatists organized under Vona.
